description: Job Records: submit a proposed policy change as structured rules (per-action caps, period caps per day, week, month or in total, allow lists, block lists and approval thresholds, each optionally limited to some counterparties, categories or services) with a batch of past job traces or payment records. The signed report replays the rules over the history in time order and states, per rule, which past actions would have been blocked, which would have needed approval and which pass unchanged, with counts and every affected record named. Supplied history only: a live x402 challenge is wever_payment-policy-check. Verdict would_block, would_need_approval or no_change. POST /api/policy-replay-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.
